items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Larry Coryell Garealle has played on two of your albums now.

ctx.x: Yeah, John Scofield, I remember his name from the record.
Anyway, I (unintelligible) he and Larry on a complete different style. Really accomplished players. [There's two playing on this He's a tuba player at the Jazz Festival.]

Do you like -- this is something I've noticed. In fact, I was totally unprepared. I was standing in a corner of the stage at Philharmonic Hall, when you walked out, at that concert. And I was totally flabbergasted at the amount of applause -- I mean, not -- it literally nearly blew me off the stage, and it was an incredible ovation. And --
